text:
Nadia (AE): Aurora Health wants a perf run next Wednesday 08:00 PT. Goal: validate hosted throughput for triage routing feature. Target: 100k req/hour, steady 20 concurrent, short bursts to 250 for 2min. Also need a quick cost estimate and a one-page summary for execs.
Sam (Perf Eng): I can own the test. Two clarifying items: expected average generated tokens per request? and will traffic be short prompts (~128 tokens) or long summaries (~2048)?
Nadia (AE): They said mix: 70% short (~150 tokens), 30% long (~1800 tokens). Model preference: rwd-7B-8k if available; otherwise fallback to rwd-3B.
Theo (Solutions): For hosted sizing I'd start with 12 workers, batching target 16-64 depending on latency. Recommend KV cache enabled and prefix caching on repeated prompts. I'll draft runbook and fallback policy.
Priya (SRE): Need to ensure VPC peering and allowlist IPs are in place. Also we should reserve a failover region in case of capacity throttling. I'll request infra for pre-warm GPUs.
Sam (Perf Eng): Proposed run sequence:
- sanity smoke (5m)
- steady-state build to 20 concurrent over 10m (maintain 60m)
- 2x burst tests: 2 min at 250 conc each, separated by 10m
- graceful ramp down
Metrics: P50/P95/P99 latency (server-side), total tokens/sec, calls/sec, queue depth, batch size histogram, GPU util, error rate.
Sam (Perf Eng): Load generator snippet (k6 JS):
```js
import http from 'k6/http';
import { sleep } from 'k6';
export default function () {
  const payload = JSON.stringify({ model: 'rwd-7B-8k', input: '<<sample prompt>>', max_new_tokens: 512 });
  http.post('https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate', payload, { headers: { Authorization: `Bearer ${__ENV.REDWOOD_KEY}`, 'Content-Type': 'application/json' } });
  sleep(0.25);
}
```
Theo (Solutions): Quick cost back-of-envelope: assume avg gen tokens/request = 400 => at 100k rph = 40M tokens/hr. I'll pull latest per-token rates but expect O($Y/day) for hosted. Will confirm with finance.
deploy-bot: Test environment provisioned: env=perf-aurora-212345; cluster=ct-aur-3456; reservation: 2026-04-01 08:00 PT.
Priya (SRE): I'll run a pre-check list: networking, IAM roles, log retention policy (set to 30 days per DPA), monitoring alert hooks. Anyone have the sample prompt corpus?
Nadia (AE): I'll upload 25 representative prompts (anonymized) to the shared bucket by EOD Monday.
Sam (Perf Eng): One more: enable warmup to avoid cold KV misses. Also capture first-request latencies separately.
Theo (Solutions): Fallback policy: if P95 > 300ms for short prompts, route to rwd-3B and re-test. For long prompts, allow higher P95 threshold (<= 700ms) but monitor tokens/sec.
Nadia (AE): Thanks team — aim to send a 1-page executive summary with a chart and key metrics within 24h of the run. Will coordinate with marketing for the slide template. :thumbsup:
